cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Make Help Define Us
cards.instruction: Get their help, then use how it is offered to redefine what the relationship means.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm lifting this end the way you did. Take the other end; let's move the table together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only lifted it to check the loose leg. It will fall off if we carry it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, checking together. Help me tighten it. I'm tired of being the friend you do everything for.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll hold the leg straight. You turn the screw until it grips.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep holding. Next time you introduce us, try 'we fix things together' instead of 'I look after him.'
